steps.subject: sky

steps.subject: sky
steps.action: yellow ochre around the edges of the yellow
steps.load: touch of yellow ochre, same brush
steps.motion: go back up, around the edges

steps.subject: sky
steps.action: bright red around the edges, little crisscross strokes

steps.action: red for the horizon

steps.subject: sky

steps.subject: cloud
steps.action: phthalo blue and crimson clouds with the corner of the brush
steps.load: more crimson than blue, a little reddish

steps.subject: cloud
steps.action: clean brush gently blends the clouds
steps.motion: little round strokes, blend just enough
steps.rule: Blend only enough to soften the edges.

steps.rule: This makes the cloud appear closer to the viewer.

steps.rule: It suggests depth and distance in the sky.

steps.subject: cloud
steps.action: streaky clouds with the fan, blended in

steps.subject: ocean/wave
steps.action: thin filbert sketch of the wave line
steps.load: dark lavender, thinned with paint thinner

steps.action: block in the dark color in the wave
steps.load: a little more alizarin crimson and phthalo blue
steps.motion: block in the dark areas, the big crasher
steps.rule: Liquid clear allows mixing on the canvas without changing value.

steps.subject: rock
steps.action: fan brush basic rock shape, far in the distance
steps.load: back and forth, not a great deal of paint
steps.motion: make a basic shape that sticks out in the water
steps.rule: This is too distant to show detail.

steps.subject: rock
steps.action: bigger rock in front

steps.new: helps suggest distance in the painting

steps.subject: rock
steps.action: little highlight to make the rock stand out

steps.action: white with the least touch of cadmium yellow along the top of the wave
steps.load: titanium white with the least touch of cadmium yellow
steps.motion: scrub color along the top of the wave
steps.where: along the top of this wave
steps.rule: Because the water is thinner here.

steps.subject: ocean/wave
steps.action: clean dry 2in brush blends the light gently

steps.action: pick up lavender from below and blend it up

steps.subject: ocean/wave
steps.action: mix a medium value with a clean dry 2in brush

steps.subject: ocean/wave
steps.action: corner of the 2in brush blends the mix gently
steps.motion: bring all this together very gently

steps.subject: ocean/wave
steps.action: thin yellow and white sparkles in the bright area
steps.load: paint thinner, thin as ink
